description: CHEAPFX, two low frequency generators for switching between two tones, each with a triangle output, a rectangle output and a gate that fades in and out

params.text: Sets the rate of that generator, 0.26Hz fully anticlockwise to 16Hz fully clockwise
Sets the shape of that generator: a falling sawtooth fully anticlockwise, a triangle at the centre and a rising sawtooth fully clockwise, and the same setting is the duty cycle of the rectangle

inputs.text: Every volt here doubles the rate of that generator, added to the FREQUENCY knob and clamped at four volts either side of zero
Every 10V here moves the shape across its whole travel, added to the SHAPE knob
A rising edge starts one cycle and fades the gate up; another trigger before the cycle ends buys a further cycle

outputs.text: A 0-10V ramp, falling, rising or peaking at the middle according to SHAPE
A 0-10V square wave whose duty cycle is set by SHAPE
Carries 0-10V while a triggered cycle runs, ramped up and down over 2000 samples so that a switch driven from it does not click

notes: the TRIANGLE and RECTANGLE outputs run whether or not a trigger has arrived; the GATE output stays at 0V until one arrives
Patch a constant voltage to the TRIGGER input to have the GATE output run continuously, as the maker's README suggests
